title: Frontend Developer (React.js)
description: We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer proficient in React.js and Tailwind CSS. You will be responsible for building pixel-perfect UIs based on Figma designs, integrating RESTful APIs, and ensuring responsive layouts across all devices. Experience with Next.js is a strong plus.

title: Full Stack Engineer (MERN)
description: Seeking a Full Stack Engineer to build scalable web applications. You will work extensively with MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js. The ideal candidate has experience building complex systems like ERPs or SaaS platforms and understands state management using tools like Zustand or Redux.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: We need a creative UI/UX designer to craft intuitive user experiences. You will create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs in Figma. Strong understanding of typography, color theory, and modern web design principles is required.

title: Backend Developer (Node.js)
description: Join our backend team to develop robust RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express. You will design database schemas in MongoDB/PostgreSQL, implement authentication, and ensure high performance and responsiveness to requests from the frontend.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description: Looking for a data-driven Product Marketing Manager to lead our go-to-market strategies. You will be responsible for market research, positioning, and working closely with the sales and product teams to drive user acquisition.

title: Software Engineer (.NET/C#)
description: We are seeking a strong backend engineer focused on the .NET ecosystem. You will build and maintain high-performance APIs using C# and manage complex queries in MSSQL. Familiarity with enterprise-level applications is highly desired.

title: React Frontend Engineer
description: Looking for an experienced React developer to take ownership of our client-facing dashboards. You should be highly comfortable with React.js, modern state management (Zustand/Redux), and translating complex data into dynamic reporting systems.

title: Full Stack Developer (C# & React)
description: Join our cross-functional team building large-scale SaaS ERP solutions. The ideal candidate can seamlessly jump between a React frontend and a .NET/MSSQL backend, ensuring data integrity and smooth user experiences across complex modules like HR and inventory.

title: E-Commerce Platform Developer
description: We need a full-stack developer to help scale our multi-vendor e-commerce platform. Experience with the MERN stack is required, along with a solid understanding of payment gateway integrations and real-time database updates using Firebase or similar technologies.

title: Database Administrator
description: Seeking a DBA to manage, optimize, and secure our core databases. Expertise in MySQL and MSSQL is mandatory. Experience implementing caching layers using Redis to improve query performance is a strong advantage.

title: Software Engineer (ERP Systems)
description: We are expanding our engineering team to build custom ERP modules for corporate clients. You will work on full-stack development, focusing on attendance, employee management, and customized data reporting. Strong JavaScript and API design skills needed.

title: Systems Analyst
description: Looking for a methodical Systems Analyst to bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution. You will analyze existing corporate workflows and architect technical solutions for large-scale system deployments.

title: Frontend Architect (TypeScript/React)
description: Take the lead on our frontend architecture. We need a specialist in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. You will set the standard for component reusability, manage complex application state, and mentor junior developers.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description: Seeking a detail-oriented QA Engineer to handle both manual and automated testing. You will write test cases, automate API testing via Postman, and ensure all web application releases meet our high-quality standards.

title: Backend Developer (.NET Core)
description: We are looking for a backend specialist to build microservices using .NET Core. You will be dealing with heavy data loads, requiring deep knowledge of SQL optimization, secure REST API development, and distributed system design.
